Submitted (the first attempt failed only on a JSON serialisation error in the `proposal` field, now corrected).

**Final position — preferred, three surgical operations in Section 3.4:**

1. **p0044** — the grant sentence is restated in full so the operative language reads "Customer may terminate this Agreement … or any Service Option Attachment … **for convenience at any time** by:", removing the month-end effective-date restriction while keeping the prerequisite Service Option Attachment carve-out verbatim.
2. **p0045** — "at least one month's prior written notice" → "at least **thirty (30) days'** prior written notice".
3. **Insert after p0047** — anchored refund sentence (per the verifier's drafting nit): "In the event of a termination by Customer for convenience under this Section 3.4, IBM will refund to Customer, pro rata, any prepaid charges for the period after the effective date of termination."

Element four (no Vendor mid-term convenience right) remains already met by Section 3.3's breach-only IBM exit, cited verbatim. Retained language — "if any" in 3.4(b), the continuing-performance sentence, and 3.3's bar on IBM recovering 3.4(b) charges after its own breach — is untouched, and the rationale records that if we ever drop to the fallback, 3.4(b) must carry an express three-month charge cap.
